body.x: QINGDAO, China (AVING) -- <Visual News> Lenovo(www.lenovo.com) presented its 14.1-inch notebook pc ‘K42A’ in China market during SINOCES(China International Consumer Electronics Show) 2007 in Qingdao. Running on Intel Core 2 Duo T7300 CPU, the K42A adopts Intel 965PM chipset, Nvidia GeForce 8400M G graphic card and Lenovo Trust Technology(LTT) enhancing stability.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'SINOCES 2007': Sophia Kwag, Xiangwo Park >
